description:
Decide how the TS client signs and verifies Ed25519 for cert auth.

Options:
1. WebCrypto subtle ('Ed25519' algorithm) — zero deps, but coverage is uneven (Firefox shipped it, Safari shipped it, Chrome/Edge as of recent versions; Node 22+ also has it). Some older targets may not.
2. @noble/ed25519 — pure JS, ~5KB, audited, works everywhere. Breaks the README's 'zero runtime dependencies' promise.
3. Hybrid: use subtle if available, fall back to noble.

Today the TS client (crypto.ts) is HMAC-only via subtle, no async key import for asymmetric keys.

Decision criteria: minimum supported browser set for shepherd's browser client (TBD on shepherd side), bundle-size budget, audit posture for the cert path. Document the decision in clients/typescript/README.md so the dep stance is clear either way.
title: TS client: pick Ed25519 implementation (subtle vs noble)
